title: Raja / Rani
description: Seated at the head of the court. Assigns petitions, pronounces verdicts, issues the day's edict — and may once test a minister's loyalty.

title: Mahamantri
description: The realm's first counsellor. Reads witnesses, untangles disputes, and parleys with enemy envoys to buy time.

title: Koshadhyaksha
description: Keeper of the royal treasury and ledgers. Audits accounts, weighs merchants' claims and pays for reinforcements.

title: Senapati
description: Keeps the guard logs and commands the troops — but in battle must move them blind, trusting the Spy Chief's word.

title: Gudhapurusha Pramukh
description: Master of the realm's hidden eyes. Alone sees where the enemy will strike, and chooses what to tell the court.

title: Nyayadhish
description: Knows the law and the customs of the court. Guides trials and weighs evidence for the Raja.

title: Sitadhyaksha
description: Oversees the crown's fields, granaries and canals. In famine, knows the true need of the villages.
